SELECT
                order_stores.id,
                COUNT(orders.id) AS orders_count,
                MONTH(orders.created_at) AS month,
                YEAR(orders.created_at) AS year
            FROM
                `<fixture-schema>`.order_stores
                    LEFT JOIN
                orders ON order_stores.order_id = orders.id
            WHERE
                store_id = 1

                    AND orders.order_status not in (0)
            GROUP BY YEAR(orders.created_at) , MONTH(orders.created_at);
